title: Order the agentic loop
intro: The loop every framework wraps in its own vocabulary — put it in order.
prompt: Drag into order, first step on top.

steps.text: Receive the goal and available tools
The model decides the next action (answer, or which tool to call)
Feed the tool result back into the context
Judge: goal met, or loop back to deciding the next action?
Stop — on success, on failure, or on hitting the attempt/budget cap

debrief: Goal → decide → act → observe → evaluate → terminate, with the evaluate step looping back to decide. Two steps get skipped in careless builds: the explicit evaluation (without it the loop runs on vibes) and the termination cap (without it the loop runs on your credit card). Every framework in this pack is a different way to make these six steps reliable — the SDK with guardrails, LangGraph with conditional edges, the capstone with budgets.
